<!--
  Delivery windows by day: each day lists its windows as radio chips; closed windows are disabled and struck
  through. One radio group (`name`) across all days. Static markup.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Day } from "./slot-grid.types";

  export type SlotGridProps = {
    days: Day[];
    name: string;
    item?: "card" | "plain";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import Radio from "../primitives/radio/radio.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { days, name, item = "card" }: SlotGridProps = $props();
</script>

<Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="days">
  {#each days as d (d.id)}
    <Stack
      gap="4"
      class={
        (item as string) === "card" ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
        : "border-b border-border pb-4"
      }
      data-testid="day"
    >
      <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {d.title}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {d.note}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {#each d.slots as s (s)}
          <Label
            class={"flex items-center gap-2 rounded px-4 py-2 text-sm inset-ring inset-ring-border has-checked:bg-muted " +
              "has-checked:inset-ring-foreground"}
          >
            <Radio name={name} value={tpl("{0} {1}", d.id, s)} />
            <Inline>
              {s}
            </Inline>
          </Label>
        {/each}
        {#each d.closed as s (s)}
          <Label
            class={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-2 rounded px-4 py-2 text-sm inset-ring inset-ring-border has-checked:bg-muted " +
                "has-checked:inset-ring-foreground",
              "text-muted-foreground line-through"
            )}
          >
            <Radio name={name} value={tpl("{0} {1}", d.id, s)} disabled={true} />
            <Inline>
              {s}
            </Inline>
          </Label>
        {/each}
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  {/each}
</Stack>
